name: Mount Kumgang – Diamond Mountain from the Sea
description: Mount Kumgang, "Diamond Mountain," rises to about 1,600 metres on North Korea's east coast, not far from the South Korean border. Pale granite peaks, plunging valleys and waterfalls shift constantly in mist, rain and cloud. Buddhists have held it sacred since the 5th century, and hermitages, stupas and rock carvings dot its slopes, with three temples still in use.
